```artifact
Decision Table for Requirement U13_4

| Condition | Add Symptom | View Symptom | Update Symptom | Delete Symptom |
|-----------|-------------|--------------|----------------|----------------|
| New Symptom | Allow | Allow | Allow | Deny |
| Existing Symptom | Allow | Allow | Allow | Check Usage |
| Symptom Used in Consultation | Deny | Allow | Allow | Deny |
| Symptom Not Used in Consultation | Allow | Allow | Allow | Allow |

Notes:
- "Allow" means the operation is permitted.
- "Deny" means the operation is prohibited.
- "Check Usage" means verify if the symptom has been used in any consultation; if not, allow deletion.
- "-" indicates a don't-care value, which has no impact on the decision.
```
